text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moroccan businessmen expected in the United States on February 22 for one-week working visit. The visit is organised by the Moroccan-American Council for Trade and Investment.
- Reforms of financial market do not dispel worries of Moroccan banks regarding the sector's future.
- Higher Education Ministry and state-owned airline Royal Air Maroc signed agreement to give researchers access to preferential fares.
- Jordan's King Hussein expected in Morocco on February 18.
